name: redact
description: Rewrites sensitive data (emails, IPs, credentials, addresses) out of what enters the model context

emails.title: Redact email addresses
emails.description: Mask email addresses appearing in tool results and attachments

ipAddresses.title: Redact IP addresses
ipAddresses.description: Mask IPv4 and IPv6 addresses appearing in tool results and attachments

credentials.title: Redact keys and credentials
credentials.description: Mask API keys, tokens, JWTs, private key blocks and secret assignments

addresses.title: Redact residential addresses
addresses.description: Mask street-style and Chinese-format residential addresses

phoneNumbers.title: Redact phone numbers
phoneNumbers.description: Mask phone numbers; off by default because plain digit runs false-positive

scrubPrompt.title: Also scrub typed prompts
scrubPrompt.description: Additionally rewrite secrets in rows the user typed; off by default so the model sees what was asked

quiet.title: Quiet mode
quiet.description: Suppress the toast shown when a row is redacted
